With an injected clock, sweep (store.sweep, `lightning sweep`, and every content append for its own run) removes runs created before the retention cutoff and content lines older than it in the remaining runs; retention outside 1-90 is refused with retention-out-of-range. `lightning purge --run-id <id> | --all` previews the runs and content bytes with a previewDigest and deletes nothing; `--apply --preview-digest` with a stale or forged digest is refused with preview-stale; a matching apply deletes each run directory (records, content, salt, lock) and leaves no content bytes in the store, while files outside the run store are untouched.
